voice.welcome: Come watch a little bean grow. Tap the glowing day to begin.
voice.future-day: That sprout day is still growing. Start with the glowing day.
voice.day-1-intro: Day one. The bean is resting in the soil. Give it water and sunshine.
voice.day-2-intro: Day two. A tiny root is awake. Give it water and sunshine.
voice.day-3-intro: Day three. A green shoot is reaching up. Give it water and sunshine.
voice.day-4-intro: Day four. Two little leaves are open. Give them water and sunshine.
voice.day-5-intro: Day five. Our bean plant is getting tall. Give it water and sunshine.
voice.water: Drip, drop. The roots drink a little water.
voice.sun: Warm sunshine helps the leaves make food.
voice.care-ready: Now draw what is new. Follow the glowing garden line.
voice.trace-1: Draw the bean's first root reaching down.
voice.trace-2: Draw the little shoot pushing up.
voice.trace-4: Trace the two bigger true leaves.
voice.trace-5: Draw two new leaves on the stem.
voice.trace-nudge: Start where the light is twinkling, then follow the garden line.
voice.care-nudge: Our bean is waiting for water and warm sunshine.
voice.success-1: Look! The bean's first root reaches down to find water.
voice.success-2: Look! The shoot pushes up and turns toward the light.
voice.success-3: Look! Two seed leaves opened like tiny green hands.
voice.success-4: Look! The first true leaves spread out to catch sunlight.
voice.success-5: Look! New leaves made our little bean plant fuller.
voice.all-grown: You watched a bean become a young plant, one careful day at a time.
voice.reset-check: Grow a brand-new bean? Tap the seed one more time.
voice.reset-done: A new bean is ready for day one.

days.observation: A first root reaches down to find water.
The shoot pushes up and turns toward the light.
Two seed leaves open like tiny green hands.
The first true leaves spread out to catch sunlight.
New leaves make the little bean plant fuller.
